title: Continuum-Lab: High-Performance GPU-Accelerated Computational Physics and Continuum Mechanics Suite
description: Continuum-Lab is an open-source, mathematically rigorous, GPU-accelerated computational physics and continuum mechanics suite. Powered by Taichi Lang and CUDA, it simulates incompressible Navier-Stokes flows, chaotic dynamic systems, elastodynamics, and complex mathematical analysis with real-time hardware acceleration.
